mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company_applicant ca JOIN job_posts jp ON jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX = ca.JOB_POSTS_IDX WHERE jp.COMPANY_IDX = #{companyIdx}
SELECT cm.JOB_POSTS_IDX FROM company_matching cm WHERE cm.COMPANY_IDX = #{companyIdx} ORDER BY cm.MATCHING_CREATEAT DESC, cm.COM_MATCHING_IDX DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ju.JOBSEEKER_NAME AS jobseekerName, cm.COM_MATCH_SCORE AS matchScore FROM company_matching cm JOIN jobseeker_users ju ON ju.JOBSEEKER_IDX = cm.JOBSEEKER_IDX WHERE cm.JOB_POSTS_IDX = #{jobPostsIdx} ORDER BY cm.COM_MATCH_SCORE DESC, cm.MATCHING_CREATEAT DESC, cm.COM_MATCHING_IDX DESC LIMIT 3
